pick_word.subtitle: Act natural and sneak into the concert!

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which girl did you like the most?
Have you ever been to a concert?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: This should be easy. It's just like sneaking out of school. We only need to stay calm, act natural, and keep moving.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Got it. If we keep up a fast pace, the security people should lose us in the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sounds easy enough. Let's go!
Dinah takes the lead as the girls try to act natural and sneak into the concert...
And they slip right past security!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We did it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe that worked!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I told you we could do it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, let's buy some souvenirs before the concert starts!
Dinah takes the lead as the girls try to act natural and sneak into the concert...
Dinah blends in with the crowd and walks through without a problem.
But as they walk past a security guard, Linda begins to freeze up!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... Can't... Move...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Just keep walking.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Can't... Paralyzed with fear...
The security guard looks over and spots them walking in without tickets!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hey! Where are your tickets?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yikes!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh oh... That guy looks familiar...
The security guard squints at Kim and Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I've seen you two before, haven't I?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's that cop from when we were helping Spike with his skate video! I guess he's working here now...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We... Uh... I don't think we've ever seen you before...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Where are your tickets?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... My... Friend has our tickets. She's already inside.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: A likely story.
Suddenly, there's a huge crashing sound as a drink cart falls over! Ice and drinks scatter across the ground!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What was that?!
The girls use the distraction to take off running!
The three of them manage to make it into the concert!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whew! I thought we were totally caught!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's a good thing he got distracted.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Now we just need to find Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Are you kidding? It'll take forever to find her. We might as well enjoy the concert.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah. Anyway, it was her bright idea to sneak in that almost got us caught.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow, I guess I know what you guys really think of me.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Dinah... I'm sure they don't mean it. After all, you did drive us all the way down here!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sorry... Linda's right.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I only meant that you ran off when we needed you.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I went to create a distraction by knocking over a drink cart!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: See? If it hadn't been for Dinah, we'd all still be back there with that security guy!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry, Dinah... I didn't mean anything by it.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay, okay. Let's just start over.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right. The concert is going to begin soon. Why don't we buy some souvenirs?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We'll have better luck finding tickets if we split up.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'll go with you, Linda.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, okay. I'll go with Kim. Dinah, you go with Mallika. How hard could this be?
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This is hopeless! We're never going to find any spare tickets!

nodes.speaker: Ticket Scalper
nodes.text: You girls are looking for tickets?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... Yes. Yes we are! Do you have any extra tickets?

nodes.speaker: Ticket Scalper
nodes.text: I've got whatever you're looking for... Front row seats? Maybe backstage passes?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That would be great! We'll take four tickets!

nodes.speaker: Ticket Scalper
nodes.text: Let's see... That'll be 500 dollars.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's... That's a lot of money...

nodes.speaker: Ticket Scalper
nodes.text: 500 dollars `each.`
nodes.text_bbcode: 500 dollars [color=#e23b3b][i]each.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We can't pay that kind of money!

nodes.speaker: Ticket Scalper
nodes.text: Then I guess you can't get into the concert... That's too bad.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What are the cheapest tickets you have?
After some bargaining, Linda and Kim buy the tickets and meet back up with Dinah and Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We found some tickets, but they weren't cheap.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But we did talk the guy down from 500 dollars to 150 dollars each.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What? That's twice the normal price!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know... But we were desperate!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So much for saving money by carpooling... This night is getting expensive!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on, let's not let this ruin our night. At least we can get in now.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That's a good point... If we're paying an arm and a leg for this concert, we'd better at least have fun!
Later, in the concert hall...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Since we've got some time before the concert starts, let's buy some souvenirs.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: After spending all of that money on the tickets? No way!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on... This is half the fun of going to a concert.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Besides, what would you do if we end up standing next to 'The Assassins', and we don't have anything for them to sign?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That would be horrible!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Exactly... So let's at least buy something for them to sign.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Speaking of going inside, we'd better buy our tickets.
The girls get to the ticket booth and see Tom Prince's limo parked just outside of it.
Walking up, they see a butler handing Tom a huge, stuffed envelope.
As the girls watch, the ticket booth closes, putting up a big 'SOLD OUT' sign.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We can't stand for this! We've got to do something!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But what can we do?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I bet Tom Prince had something to do with this! Let me go talk to him.
Mallika confronts Tom Prince near the ticket booth.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, Tom, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I don't know what you're referring to.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Unless you're referring to the fact that I bought all of the remaining concert tickets so you wouldn't be able to get in.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If that's the case, then I know exactly what you're referring to.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Why would you do that?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because no one gets away with humiliating Tom Prince, Mallika. No one.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're keeping us out of the concert because of one stupid date?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You threw me into the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, Prince. How much do you want for the tickets?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Oh, Mallika... There's not enough money in the world to convince me to part with any of these tickets.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Good luck getting into the concert.
Mallika returns empty-handed to the other girls.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What did you find out?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That Tom Prince is a jerk. He bought out the rest of the tickets just so we won't be able to get in!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I can't believe he'd stoop that low!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Believe it.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, what's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Look, we didn't come all this way just to miss out on the best concert of the year! There's got to be a way to get in.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Maybe we can buy tickets from someone who has too many...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Or we could just try to sneak in.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess since Tom Prince already 'bought' the tickets, the band won't be losing any money.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay, those are both good ideas, but we'd better decide fast. The concert's going to start soon! We should...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You leave Mallika alone! You're nothing but an arrogant, insensitive idiot!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How dare you?! Do you know who I am?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know who you are! I used to think you were a great guy, but now I know the truth!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You're just a horrible person trying to use money to cover up the ugly truth of who you are!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'd stay out of this, if I were you!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm not afraid of you! You're just a big bully!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You two can't speak to me like this!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm important! I'm rich! You're just a couple of nobodies!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Money can't buy you personality... Or friends!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: To tell you the truth, I sincerely hope I never even see you again!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, I think you'll be seeing me again!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whatever. Come on, Linda. Let's get out of here.
Linda and Mallika leave Tom Prince behind and rejoin Kim and Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe the limo was just for Tom Prince... I wonder where the band is...
The girls hear cheering coming from the building! They turn in time to see a helicopter landing on the roof!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: There goes the band... We're so far away, I can barely see them!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Sorry, guys. I shouldn't have wasted so much time arguing with Tom Prince...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, don't worry about it. We're going to be seeing 'The Assassins' all night once we get inside!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Calm down, Mallika. He isn't worth getting upset over.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But... He...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There's nothing we can do about him right now. Come on, we're here to enjoy the concert. Do you really want to let him ruin it for us?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Then let's just go. To be honest, he's not worth our time.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You're right, Linda! Let's get out of here.
The girls leave and Tom Prince gets back in his limo.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ugh! I can't believe that guy...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We heard everything. You did the right thing by walking away. Arguing with someone like that never solves anything!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: You know, you're right! I'm glad I didn't get into a fight with him. I don't think he'd ever listen to reason.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, but if Tom Prince was in the limo... Where's the band?
In the distance, a helicopter appears!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That must be them! Hurry!
The girls run up to the outside of the building where the concert is being held.
The crowd starts to cheer as the helicopter hovers over the roof of the building!
The band climbs down a rope ladder! Each band member waves at the fans before heading into the entrance.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow! That was amazing!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe that really just happened!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: See? I told you guys. This is going to be fun.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I've got a good feeling about our luck tonight.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah! We've already seen an amazing entrance by the band, and we haven't even gone inside yet.
The car ride continues in an uncomfortable silence.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I feel so silly for fighting earlier...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: If Dinah can get over her fear of driving, I should be able to get along with Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I was just a kid... Only seven years old.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: My mom was driving me home from school one day...

nodes.speaker: Young Dinah
nodes.text: Mom! I want to go to the toy store! I want to buy a pink teddy bear! I want to eat candy!

nodes.speaker: DINAH'S MOM
nodes.text: One thing at a time, Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Young Dinah
nodes.text: I want a doll! I want cotton candy!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Then there was a horrible screeching sound...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: By the time my mom saw the truck coming towards us, it was too late...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Dinah... I'm so sorry... That must have been terrible!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That accident changed my life.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But at least you and your mom were okay, right?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah. That's right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whew. For a minute there, I thought something `really` bad had happened...
nodes.text_bbcode: Whew. For a minute there, I thought something [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] bad had happened...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, anyway, why don't you take a break for a minute?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah... We've got plenty of time before the concert.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: We can wait... We'll move on when you're ready.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That sounds good.
The girls return to the car, and Dinah pulls out her cell phone.
Dinah punches in a number and waits for someone to answer.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Dad? Are you there?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I just wanted to check in. I'm fine. We're still a couple of hours away from the concert.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm being careful.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I was on the freeway for over an hour, and I didn't freak out at all.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, I know... I know it's what Mom would have wanted. I miss her too.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'll be safe. Love you.
After a short break, the girls are back on the road.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know something's bothering you... And I know you're hiding it from me.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: As your friend, I think I have the right to know.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Just leave me alone!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Linda... Dinah might just need to deal with this by herself.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But... I was only trying to help.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You don't know what you're talking about.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I won't know until you tell me.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Fine... I'll tell you what happened... But only so you'll leave me alone.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If there's anything you want to talk about, I'm here for you. But if you're not ready, I understand.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Thanks, Linda. I... I think I might feel better if we talk.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Do you... Want some privacy?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's okay... I'm not crazy or anything. I just want to explain why I get so shaken up when I drive sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... On most days, I don't have any trouble driving. It's just...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: A long time ago, something bad happened to me.
Suddenly, an expensive foreign car cuts Dinah off, nearly causing an accident as it speeds by!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Ahhhh!!!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What a jerk...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: At least he missed us. Are you okay, Dinah? ...Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I... I... I need to pull over for a minute.
Dinah pulls off of the freeway and parks along the nearest street.
Then she gets out of the car and starts pacing on the sidewalk.
The other girls climb out of the car to check on Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey! Are you feeling okay?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... Yeah. I was just startled, that's all.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Are you sure? You seem really shaken up. Let's take a break from driving for a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe... Maybe that's a good idea. But don't we need to hurry to make sure we get there in time to buy our tickets?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't worry about the time. We're plenty early, and the venue is huge.
Dinah sits down on the side of the curb.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Right... I think I just need a break for a minute.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Dinah...

options.label: We can give you some space.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'll start. Spike!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay. Kim?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... You can't both use the same person... The point of the game is to come up with new answers...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What? Just because she said his name first, that means she gets him? That's not fair!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, calm down! There are tons of cute guys in our town... You can't tell me that Spike is the `only` guy you think is cute!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, calm down! There are tons of cute guys in our town... You can't tell me that Spike is the [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] guy you think is cute!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well... I guess Hector is pretty hot.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hee hee... I'll agree with that!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: For my turn... I think Howard and Kenji are the cutest guys at our school. Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... Brendan is cute.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Heh. Brendan? Isn't he kind of nerdy?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Nerdy doesn't bother me. Besides, he's funny and sweet... In his own way...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mallika, it's back to your turn.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well... Um... I used to think that Tom Prince was cute... Until I found out what a jerk he is!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What happened with Tom Prince? I think all the girls I know had a crush on him at some point...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It turned out that he's a complete snob! He's self-centered, spoiled, and completely irritating!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe I actually went on a date with him...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You dated Tom Prince?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Trust me, he's a jerk. I'd rather go on another date with Skazz than ever see Tom Prince again!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Skazz?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom Prince and then Skazz?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Heh... I guess I have a crazy dating history.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: At least you `have` a dating history...
nodes.text_bbcode: At least you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] a dating history...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Please... I think I'd prefer none at all to having Tom Prince and Skazz on my record. My date with Tom Prince ended with me throwing him in the ocean!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I guess it is pretty funny... But trust me, he deserved it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'll start! This might sound silly, but I really love the old classic 'Pride and Piracy'. Dinah, your turn.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: 'Hacksaw IV: The Bloodening'. It might not sound that romantic, but it had a really touching ending.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay... That's weird, but I'll accept it. Mallika?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hmm... I liked 'The Time Traveler's Second Cousin'.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Kim, your turn.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... I liked 'Wedding Crushers'.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That wasn't a romantic movie! There wasn't anything romantic about that movie.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yes, it was! Did you even see it?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well... No...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But I'm sure it's a terrible movie!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, if Dinah can use 'Hacksaw IV: The Bloodening', then I think I can use 'Wedding Crushers'.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What's wrong with 'Hacksaw IV'?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Nothing... I'm just saying that if a hack and slash movie can count as being 'romantic', then a movie like 'Wedding Crushers' should be able to count too.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: And who made `you` the movie police?
nodes.text_bbcode: And who made [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] the movie police?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I wasn't trying to police anything! Mallika is the one who started it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This game was supposed to bring everyone together... But it's only made things worse...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's Mallika's fault.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No way! You're the cheater!
And so the girls embark on their road trip. Dinah puts on the band's newest album to keep the peace in the car...

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: { Are we people? Or are we praaaaancers? You gotta let me knooooooow! {
But as the minutes wear on, the girls grow restless.

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: { Are we people? Or are we praaaaancers? You gotta let me knooooooow! {

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but this is the fourteenth time we've heard this song. Maybe it's time to give it a rest.
Dinah stops the music.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: But... What are we going to do without music?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's play a travel game.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know... Those are usually pretty lame.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know a couple of fun ones... Hey, how about 'Categories'? We pick a category, and then we go around, each naming something in that category. If you can't think of anything, you're out!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: To warm up, we'll try something easy... How about...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Just give it a chance. Dinah has the latest album by 'The Assassins', so we can sing along to their music all the way there!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... Don't count me in for the sing-along, but I do love their latest album.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I brought lots of snacks. How about some 'Smoreos', 'Cheese-Hits', or 'Scattles'?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I love 'Scattles'!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ugh... We actually have something in common...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Come on, let's hit the road.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What are you talking about? It'll take three hours just to get there!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ugh... And then another three hours after the concert...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: One of us shouldn't go.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Right. So why don't you back off?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What? Why should `I` be the one to miss the concert?
nodes.text_bbcode: What? Why should [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] be the one to miss the concert?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I was here first.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So based on that logic, you should give up on Spike! I dated him first!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But I knew him first!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Anyway, look, I'm not going to skip the concert, so why don't you just go home and have a nice quiet night of indie movies and vegan popcorn?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No way! I'm not backing down!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, I'm not backing down either!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So... I guess that means we're both going.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Looks like it.
Linda and Dinah exchange worried looks...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What have we gotten ourselves into?

nodes.title: The Concert
nodes.subtitle: Will they make it to the show?

nodes.text: With 'The Assassins' giving an unscheduled concert a few towns over, some of the Centerscore kids are scrambling to find a way to get there.
Luckily for Linda, Dinah has a car...
But with travel costs running high, they're looking for a couple of lucky people to carpool with them...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I can't believe 'The Assassins' just announced this unscheduled concert!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I just wish they had announced it sooner... This doesn't leave us much time to find people to carpool with us.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I wonder if anyone will see the ad we put in today's school newspaper.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I hope so. It would be nice to get a couple of people to split the cost of gas with us... It `is` a three-hour drive just to get there, after all.
nodes.text_bbcode: I hope so. It would be nice to get a couple of people to split the cost of gas with us... It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a three-hour drive just to get there, after all.

nodes.text: Elsewhere at Centerscore High, Mallika flips through the school newspaper...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, an offer to carpool to tonight's concert...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I really want to see 'The Assassins'... And carpooling is a great way to save the environment!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It says here that I just need to show up at the parking lot after school...
And across campus, Kim skims the school paper during study hall...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, someone else at this school wants to go to the concert tonight!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Carpooling would be a lot easier than trying to talk my parents into letting me borrow the car at the last minute...
And so, after school...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey. Did you guys post in the newspaper about going to the concert tonight?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yup! That's us. You help us pay for gas, and Dinah will do the driving.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Awesome. I don't have a car, so I figured there was no way I could get there!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Heh. I guess being a senior has some perks.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But wait a second... Don't we need tickets?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The tickets are only being sold at the door. Don't worry, we should get there in plenty of time to get them.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Speaking of which, we should head out. I guess it's just the three of us...
As the girls are about to climb into Dinah's car, Mallika comes running up.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey! Is this the car headed to the concert?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mallika... What're you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm here to get a ride... Wait, you're going to the concert too?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, I didn't sign up to be in a car with `her` for six hours!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I didn't sign up to be in a car with [color=#3b78e2][i]her[/i][/color] for six hours!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait, wait... Just calm down, everyone.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Calm down? Maybe you haven't heard, but Kim has been flirting with my guy!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: He's not 'her guy'! They aren't even dating! They had a summer fling... That was it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hold on. Tonight isn't about guys! Tonight is about 'The Assassins'! Live! In concert!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah! Linda's right. Can't you forget about guys for one night?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Besides...

options.label: We'll be there before you know it.

rounds.subtitle: Act natural and sneak into the concert!
Act natural and sneak into the concert!

nodes.text: Kim whispers angrily to Linda...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I thought you played sports.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I do...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Then channel that killer instinct! Think of them as the opposing team! Come on, we need to intimidate them.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm all over this!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You? Little Miss Popular?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: For your information, I'm on the soccer team! I've faced down opposing teams that were `much` tougher than you two!
nodes.text_bbcode: For your information, I'm on the soccer team! I've faced down opposing teams that were [color=#3b78e2][i]much[/i][/color] tougher than you two!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Still want to start something, Travis?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hah. You girls are all talk. I bet you won't really stop us from taking those pictures and just walking away!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh yeah?
The girls sing their hearts out!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: { And I'm on my feeeeet, searchin' for the response! {

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: { Are we people? Or are we praaaaancers? {

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: { You gotta let me knooooooow! {
The girls end the song, and audience bursts into thunderous applause!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Whoa! Judging by that response, I think we have our winners!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yay!
After getting their prizes, the girls leave the stage.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That was some good teamwork up there!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah! We really pulled that off!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And we took home the prize!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm keeping this signed picture for the rest of my life!
The girls begin walking back to their seats when...
Mallika runs into Travis!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Er... Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You just spilled my 'Mountain Spew' all over me!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It... It was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, I know how they can make it up to us... By handing over those autographed pictures of 'The Assassins'!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What?! No way!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: We're not giving you a choice. Give us those pictures!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey!
Kim steps between Travis and Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What are you trying to pull? Anyone can see that she didn't do it on purpose. You should cut her some slack.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Really? Says who? You?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mallika, are you with me?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Linda, back me up here...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh...
Kim whispers angrily to Linda...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I thought you played sports.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I do...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Then channel that killer instinct! Think of them as the opposing team! Come on, we need to intimidate them.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm all over this!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You? Little Miss Popular?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: For your information, I'm on the soccer team! I've faced down opposing teams that were `much` tougher than you two!
nodes.text_bbcode: For your information, I'm on the soccer team! I've faced down opposing teams that were [color=#3b78e2][i]much[/i][/color] tougher than you two!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Still want to start something, Travis?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hah. You girls are all talk. I bet you'll pay up and let us walk away without a fight!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh yeah? You really think we're just bluffing?
The music starts up, and the girls begin to sing...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: { I'm... On... My feeeet! {

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Linda, you're singing off-key!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sorry! Uh... What's the next line?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I... I can't remember!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Dinah! Mallika! Why aren't you singing?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So... Many... People...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: This is embarrassing! Let's just give up!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm with you!
As the crowd begins to boo, Dinah and Mallika run off the stage!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe it's time to give up...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No way! We can't quit!
Kim and Linda finish out the song...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: { You gotta let me knooooow! {

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: { Knoooow? {

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Okay, I think we've heard just about enough from that team...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: The clear winners of this contest are... `Travis and Ryan!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The clear winners of this contest are... [i]Travis and Ryan![/i]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: At least that's over...
As Travis and Ryan claim their autographed prizes, Kim and Linda get off the stage. They find Mallika and Dinah waiting for them.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What was that all about?! You totally deserted us!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I wasn't about to stand up there and look like a total idiot!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Coward!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey! Calm down, everyone! This was supposed to be a fun competition...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... Let's just watch the rest of the concert, okay? I don't want to miss anything.
The girls begin walking back to their seats when...
Mallika runs into Travis!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Er... Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: You just spilled my 'Mountain Spew' all over my autographed picture of 'The Assassins'!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Maybe you can dry it off?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: It's totally messed up!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It... It was an accident.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sure. I bet you're just sore losers! You'd better give us some cash for that picture you ruined!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey!
Kim steps between Travis and Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What are you trying to pull? Anyone can see that she didn't do it on purpose. You should cut her some slack.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Really? Says who? You?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mallika, are you with me?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Linda, back me up here...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh...
As the girls look to the stage, 'The Assassins' step up and begin playing!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I love this song!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe we're really here!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I know! We're really watching `Brad Tulips` sing live!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know! We're really watching [color=#3b78e2][i]Brad Tulips[/i][/color] sing live!

nodes.text: After two hours of playing, 'The Assassins' take a break.
An announcer comes to the front of the stage and speaks to the audience...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: While the band takes five, we're going to entertain you with a `karaoke contest!`
nodes.text_bbcode: While the band takes five, we're going to entertain you with a [i]karaoke contest![/i]

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Each member of the winning group will win an autographed picture of 'The Assassins'!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: We have staff members walking around to pick a few teams to be our lucky contestants... If you're interested, let us know!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That sounds amazing! We should try it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No way! Count me out!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I think we should try it! Come on, don't you want that autographed picture?!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That would be cool...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey! Over here! We want to enter the contest!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Pick us!!!
A short time later, the girls take the stage!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I can't believe we got picked for this...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Between Kim and Linda shouting over everyone else, I would have been surprised if we `didn't` get picked.
nodes.text_bbcode: Between Kim and Linda shouting over everyone else, I would have been surprised if we [color=#3b78e2][i]didn't[/i][/color] get picked.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Watching all of these other groups perform is nerve-wracking. Did we have to go last?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yes! To maximize our impact on the audience!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, no more debating! We need to focus!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Is that Ryan and Travis performing next? I didn't know those guys were coming to the concert...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Look on the bright side... They can't be that good at singing... Right?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: { Comin' out of my rage, and I've been doin' okay... {

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: { Need to, need to be down 'cause I don't want to faaall! {

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: They're... They're...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They're good!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, what do you expect? Ryan is a diss battler... He understands timing and rhythm...
Ryan and Travis finish the song, and the crowd applauds.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Okay, that's it for Travis and Ryan's rendition of 'Mr. Blightside'! Now it's time for Mallika, Kim, Linda, and Dinah, who will be singing 'Prancer'! Let's hear it for them!
The crowd cheers as the spotlight turns to the four girls!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We've got to win! Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe we should all buy t-shirts! Then we'd match.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That sounds kind of silly, but those shirts do look nice...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Besides, just think about it... You could get 'The Assassins' to sign your shirt! Then you could wear it to school to show it off.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, you convinced me!
The girls buy the shirts...
And one short change later...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Nice! We look great!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I thought it would be cheesy to get matching shirts...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But this is kind of fun!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yup! Now we'd better go find seats.
The girls turn to leave and see a huge swarm of people!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... It got really crowded while we were buying this stuff. We're going to have to fight our way through all of these people!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I've got an idea. Have you noticed that all of the event staff are wearing shirts like these?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah, but they've also got badges...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No one will look that closely... Just follow my lead.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey! Get out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Coming through! We've got a show to put on here, people!
As the girls start to walk through the crowd, people move to get out of their way!

nodes.speaker: Random Fan
nodes.text: Hey, look at those four hot girls! Are they with the band?

nodes.speaker: Another Fan
nodes.text: Better give them some room...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hee hee... I guess the four of us look pretty impressive together.
The girls make it through the crowd without any trouble.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I can't believe it, but this has been fun. I'm glad we all came to this concert together.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Don't forget, the concert hasn't even started yet!
Linda and Dinah buy posters while Kim and Mallika buy shirts...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's go sit down before the concert starts.
The girls turn to leave and see a huge swarm of people!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... It got really crowded while we were buying this stuff. We're going to have to fight our way past all of these people!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Let's just stick close together... We should be able to make it through.
As the girls push their way through the crowd, the posters start to get crushed!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh no! Our posters!
By the time the girls make it past the mob of people, the posters are completely ripped and rumpled!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: They're... They're totally ruined!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: This is terrible...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What a total waste of money...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess we should've gotten the shirts...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, forget about that. The concert's about to start!
Notes...
The girls go over to one of the stands selling t-shirts, posters, and hats.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What should we get?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Posters would be easier for the band to autograph... If we even get a chance to ask.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait! If we get t-shirts, we could change into them right now! Then 'The Assassins' would be able to see that we're supporting them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm going to buy a...
Linda and Kim stare down Travis and Ryan!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Look, just back off. The concert's about to start back up... Do you really want to miss it?

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Fine... You girls aren't worth missing the rest of the concert.
Ryan and Travis leave.
The girls go back to their seats...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wow... Thanks for standing up for us.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... That was really cool of you guys.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm not afraid of Ryan... And Travis is a jerk.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Heh... And I hate backing down from a challenge.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim... I know we've had our differences... But thanks. You're a lot cooler than I gave you credit for.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No sweat. We've been through a lot together today... I'm not about to let some idiots push us around.
Officer Monte steps forward to escort the girls out...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No way! I'm not leaving without a fight!
Monte tries to grab Mallika, but she pulls away from him!
Mallika takes off running! Kim, Linda, and Dinah follow her!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Don't let them get away!
The girls run all through the concert, eventually ending up near the stage...
Where Mallika trips over the pyrotechnic machine!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Fire!
Just then 'The Assassins' return to the stage, and everyone cheers.
But after the band plays a few songs, Mallika gets pulled aside by a security guard!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's her! She doesn't belong here.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tom?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks to that karaoke competition, I knew you'd managed to get in... And I knew exactly where to find you!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What are you trying to do?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm not `trying` to do anything. What I `am` doing is kicking you out of `my` concert!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not [color=#e23b3b][i]trying[/i][/color] to do anything. What I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] doing is kicking you out of [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] concert!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: This isn't your concert! You can't do this!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I bought over half of the total tickets for this event. I think that makes this my concert.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Besides, after the generous tip I've just given this fine fellow here, I think he'll have no qualms about enforcing the rules the way `I` see them.
nodes.text_bbcode: Besides, after the generous tip I've just given this fine fellow here, I think he'll have no qualms about enforcing the rules the way [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] see them.

nodes.text: Tom turns to the security guard...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Get this riffraff out of here!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Miss... You and your friends need to come with me.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Your outrage makes this moment of victory all the sweeter... Please, just keep in mind that you can thank Mallika for this.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now get out of my concert!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: All right, now pay up, girls. I think an autographed picture of 'The Assassins' should be worth about `100 dollars!`
nodes.text_bbcode: All right, now pay up, girls. I think an autographed picture of 'The Assassins' should be worth about [color=#e23b3b][i]100 dollars![/i][/color]

nodes.text: After rifling through all of their purses, the girls manage to come up with the cash.
Linda reluctantly hands over the money.
Linda and Kim try to stare down Ryan and Travis...
But Linda cracks!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I can't take it! Don't hurt us! Waaah!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Hah! I knew you were all talk!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whimper...
Glare...
Time for a showdown!

nodes.speaker: Random Fan
nodes.text: Hey! It's those girls! The ones who ruined the concert!

nodes.speaker: Another Fan
nodes.text: You tried to kill 'The Assassins'!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It was an accident!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: All the same... Maybe we should get out of here!
The girls pile into Dinah's car and drive away from the concert as an angry mob runs after their car.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Speed up, Dinah! They're gaining on us!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm going as fast as I can!
The fans hurl soda cans and other trash at Dinah's car as she speeds away...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: At least we got out of there in one piece...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You know it's a bad road trip when the best thing you can say is that you survived.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I just want to go home and forget this ever happened!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You know, if Tom Prince hadn't thrown us out of the concert, none of this would have happened! So really, Mallika, this is all your fault.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: How can you possibly blame this on me? You and Linda were the ones who wanted to do the stupid karaoke contest, and that's how he found us!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Please... Can everyone just stop fighting? Maybe we can play a travel game...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Don't get me started on you! I've had just about enough stupid travel games.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't snap at me! If you and Mallika weren't always at each other's throats, we might have actually had a fun trip!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey! Everyone! Be quiet!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Since we all hate each other, let's just be quiet until the car ride's over!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Finally... Something I can agree with.
After a very long and depressing drive home, Linda scans the television channels for something to watch.
She stops at a news program.

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: And tonight's top story: Four girls ruin what should have been an amazing concert, nearly killing the famous band, 'The Assassins'.

nodes.speaker: Random Fan
nodes.text: I don't know why they would `do` something like that... Those girls are monsters! Monsters!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know why they would [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] something like that... Those girls are monsters! Monsters!

nodes.speaker: Television
nodes.text: Early reports indicate that 'The Assassins' may cancel the rest of the tour, just in case there are any more murderous fans out there.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's... That's all our fault! We never should have left home...
Fleeing from the concert? Starting a fire that nearly takes out the band? Being blamed for ruining the rest of the tour?!
This is a terrible ending! You couldn't get a worse one if you tried...
Do you really want to leave Linda like this? Try again! There's still hope for a better ending!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.text: The security guard kicks the girls out of the concert. They sadly walk to Dinah's car.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I can't believe your stupid grudge against Tom Prince got us kicked out of the concert!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I hate to say it, Mallika, but Kim is right. First he tried to keep us from even getting in, and now he gets us thrown out?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This trip would have been a lot better if you'd just stayed home.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Are you really blaming me for this? I can't control what Tom Prince does. He's a jerk, plain and simple!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, can everyone `please` stop arguing? It's a long way home, and I'm the one who has to do all the driving.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, can everyone [color=#3b78e2][i]please[/i][/color] stop arguing? It's a long way home, and I'm the one who has to do all the driving.

nodes.text: The girls climb into Dinah's car. Dinah starts the engine and begins the long drive back home.
Dinah drives through the night as the girls sit in a sullen silence. As the minutes slowly pass, it begins to rain.
After a few minutes, the light rain turns into a downpour!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's raining pretty hard...
Suddenly, there's a loud banging sound as one of the car's tires blows out!
Dinah wildly swings the wheel to the right, pulling the car off the road.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It sounded like you got a flat... I'm really hoping that you've got a spare tire in your trunk.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I've got a bad feeling about this.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This shouldn't be a big deal. Let's just call for a tow truck.
Linda flips open her cell phone...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's weird... I'm not getting any reception...
The other girls quickly pull out their phones.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Nothing...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Not even a single bar.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Nothing here either. What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I know what we have to do... But none of you are going to like it.
A short time later, the girls shiver as they stand in the rain outside of Dinah's car.
Kim uses a flashlight to check on Dinah's car.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's freezing out here!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't think there's any hope for the tire... And since Dinah doesn't have a spare, we'll have to walk to the nearest town. I'll take the lead.
The girls tromp through the rain, following the highway as it winds through the countryside.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: All I see are trees for miles and miles. Wow, Dinah, could you have picked a worse place to break down?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's not like I wanted this to happen!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey! Stop complaining. I'm trying to figure out which way to go!

nodes.speaker: Mysterious Noise
nodes.text: Ooooooooo!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Did you hear that?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... Just the wind! It's got to be just the wind!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I... I thought I just heard something behind me...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Stop being such a wimp, Mallika!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You shouldn't snap at her, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Linda's right... I think we're all feeling a little nervous right now.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Fine, fine... I'm sorry I snapped at you, Mallika.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Mallika?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What, now you're not talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, Mallika? Is something wrong?
The girls turn to look at Mallika, but instead they find a creepy, sinister looking man!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Eeek!
The light of the flashlight dies, plunging the girls into complete darkness...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Where is everyone?!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I can't see anything!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The flashlight won't turn on!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Heh... Heh... Heh...
Yikes! It's not looking good for the girls...
If you'd played just a little bit better, maybe the girls would have ended up being friends...
Instead of being hunted down by a crazy monster!
You'd better try this episode again!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.text: Later that night, after the fire trucks put out the blaze...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I... I guess we're just lucky that no one got hurt...
We really wish we could show you the bonus scene... But you didn't quite get a perfect score!
Try again to see if you can win it!
The girls go out to the parking lot...
And pile into Dinah's car.
But as Dinah begins to back out, a limo speeds by, scraping the side of her car!

nodes.speaker: DINAH'S MOM
nodes.text: Eeeeek!!!

nodes.speaker: DINAH'S MOM
nodes.text: What happened?! Is everyone okay?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, calm down. Everyone's fine. It was just a scrape.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh... Right... Just a scrape.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: If that was Tom Prince... I'm not letting him get away with wrecking your car, Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Right!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Heh... Thanks, girls...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Linda, let's go after that limo! I want to give Tom Prince a piece of my mind!
Mallika and Linda jump out of the car and start running after the limo!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Stupid limos... I bet it `was` that jerk Tom Prince... Who else would just drive off?
nodes.text_bbcode: Stupid limos... I bet it [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] that jerk Tom Prince... Who else would just drive off?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait... Mallika, look!
The limo stops! The door opens...
And out steps Brad Tulips, the lead singer of 'The Assassins'!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's... It's...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: BRAD TULIPS!!! EEEEK!

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, ladies. We've got a new limo driver tonight, and he must have taken that last turn too sharply!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's... It's... It's an honor to have your limo hit our car, Mr. Tulips!

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: Please, call me Brad.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Um... Wait... Didn't you arrive in a helicopter?

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: Hah... Clever girl! That was just a stunt for the crowds... It's hardly practical. When we leave our concerts, we prefer to travel to our hotel by car.

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: Speaking of cars, I really can't leave yours damaged like this.

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: Would you allow me to give you and your friends a ride home? We'll take the limo, and I'll see to it that your car is properly repaired.

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: Leave it to me... And by 'me', I mean 'my personal assistant'.

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: Assistant!

nodes.speaker: Assistant
nodes.text: Yes sir?

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: Get this girl's car repaired and delivered to her home by morning.

nodes.speaker: Assistant
nodes.text: Yes, Mr. Tulips. Not a problem.

nodes.speaker: Tulips
nodes.text: I'll go tell the band to make room for the four of you.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This. Is. Unreal.
Dinah and Kim jump out of the car.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Was that Brad Tulips?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yes! And to make up for hitting Dinah's car, he's giving us a ride home!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And his assistant is going to take the car to get fixed up.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No one is going to believe this happened to us...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Then I guess we'd better take lots of pictures in the limo!
Nice work! The girls are getting some star treatment...
But more importantly, they're actually getting along!
Thanks to you, the girls have a great start to some new friendships.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, fine! Now you've done enough damage. Get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Whatever. Enjoy the rest of the concert!
The girls return to their seats...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, Kim? Thanks for standing up for us.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... That was really cool of you guys... Even if it didn't work out so well.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm not afraid of Ryan... And Travis is a jerk.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sorry, girls... I really let everyone down.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Hey, at least you had the guts to `try` to stand up to him... I got so flustered when they confronted us... I've never been very intimidating.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, at least you had the guts to [color=#3b78e2][i]try[/i][/color] to stand up to him... I got so flustered when they confronted us... I've never been very intimidating.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah... You two are really brave.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No sweat. We've been through a lot together today... I'm not about to let some idiots push us around.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I just wish it had ended better...

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Um... Thanks for driving us, Dinah. This concert was so last-minute that I didn't think I'd be able to go.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, me too. I really didn't want to miss this. I love concerts.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Heh. No problem. I love 'The Assassins'! Their angsty lyrics are as good as goth poetry!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I'm really looking forward to the artistic costumes and lighting that 'The Assassins' use. They really know how to put on a show.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: How about you, Linda? What are you excited about seeing?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Heh... I just think Brad Tulips is hot!
A little while later, Dinah pulls up to the concert venue!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We're here!
Everyone piles out of the car.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I can't believe we made it!
Just then, a white stretch limo turns into the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoa! A limo! That's got to be 'The Assassins'!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You just might be right! Lets run up and try to get an autograph!
The girls run towards the limo!
Mallika and Linda get there first. They watch as the door to the limo opens...
And Tom Prince steps out of the limo!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tom Prince?!
Linda signals to Kim and Dinah that they'd better stay back.
And begins to back away when Tom Prince speaks...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Mallika? How nice of you and your friend to rush to greet me.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Er... You two know each other?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: It's... It's a long story. We went on a date, and it didn't go so well.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Even though we last parted on less than ideal terms over the summer, I'm willing to forgive and forget after this little display of devotion...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ugh... Tom, I'm not asking for forgiveness! `I` didn't do anything wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... Tom, I'm not asking for forgiveness! [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] didn't do anything wrong!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: In fact, I think I behaved quite well considering you're a complete jerk!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is that so?! Well, we'll see who gets the last laugh!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Grr...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Should... Should I say something?
The girls go over to one of the stands selling t-shirts, posters, and hats.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: What should we get?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Posters would be easier for the band to autograph... If we even get a chance to ask.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wait! If we get t-shirts, we could change into them right now! Then 'The Assassins' would be able to see that we're supporting them!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm going to buy a...
Time for a showdown!
Later that night, after the fire trucks put out the blaze...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I... I guess we're just lucky that no one got hurt...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I feel so silly for fighting earlier... Dinah's story really puts things with Kim into perspective.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: If Dinah can get over her fear of driving for the sake of this road trip, I should be able to get along with Mallika...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ugh... I guess I need to try to get along with her.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So... Uh... This car ride hasn't been too bad.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Exactly what I was thinking... Maybe we should play that category-listing game a few more times.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sure! Let's play!
The rest of the car ride passes with pleasant conversation and entertaining games...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Fire!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Tigers!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... Um... I can't think of anything! I give up!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! That was so funny! I can't believe you couldn't think of something that's orange. What about an orange?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, I would have been able to think of something if I weren't driving.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Speaking of which...
Just then 'The Assassins' return to the stage, and everyone cheers as they begin their next set of songs.
The band puts on a spectacular show that has everyone crying at the slow songs...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sniffle...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim, are you crying?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No! It's just... This song always gets to me.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Heh. I know how you feel. This is my favorite song on the album.
And everyone rocks out during the fast songs!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I wonder if there's a mosh pit near the stage...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You mosh? You're tougher than I thought you were...
Eventually, the band plays their final song, and the concert ends.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That was the best concert ever!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'll agree to that.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Let's head home.
Travis snatches the autographed pictures from Kim and Linda.

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: We'll be taking these.
But that's not all! It looks like you've played a perfect game!
You know what that means... Time for a bonus scene!
Let's see what happened at school the week after the concert.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So how was the concert? Did you have fun?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... It was a lot of fun. Mallika and Kim ended up coming with us. I was worried that the girls wouldn't get along...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But it went better than I'd ever imagined! We even got to meet Brad Tulips!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No way!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yup! The whole night was amazing! We all had a great time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's cool... I guess you made some new friends.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Heh... I guess I did!
Later that day, in study hall...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah, Kim's actually pretty cool.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You can't really believe that...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I know you don't get along with her...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And I know Kim and I both like Spike... But after this weekend, I can honestly say that she seems like a good person.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Fine... Be friends with her. But don't come crying to me when she tries to steal your man.
And at lunch...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh, hey, Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I was just about to eat.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Let's grab a table.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I think I see Linda sitting over there... Maybe we can join her.
Well, that does it for this bonus scene.
Congratulations again on your perfect game!
See you next time!
